page_title: FRE 2-1 HEI | Freiburg v Heidenheim 19/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
90+4' It looks like Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) saw red with that tackle. Patrick Ittrich won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Heidenheim have a free kick.

90+1' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) makes sure he wins the cross from Christian Conteh near the penalty spot but is unable to get his header on target, sending it narrowly wide of the right post.
87' Heidenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
85' The game has come to an end for Lukas Kubler. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg).
83' 2 - 1 Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Diant Ramaj. 2:1.
80' Heidenheim string together a series of short passes.
78' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) latched on to a good low pass and attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a snap shot, but the ball skewed off his foot flew well over the bar.
78' Substitution. Christian Gunter makes his way off the pitch and Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) comes on as his replacement.
76' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) replaces Mathias Honsak.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niklas Dorsch leaves the pitch and Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) comes on.

75' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Patrick Ittrich with no other option than to blow for a foul.

74' That was close by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
73' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
73' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
72' Substitution. Arijon Ibrahimovic makes way for Christian Conteh (Heidenheim).
71' The attendance is 34000.
70' Patrick Ittrich has issued a yellow card to Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
68' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Johan Manzambi is replaced by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
68' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) in, Derry Scherhant out.
68' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Igor Matanovic will be replaced by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg).
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.

64' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Diant Ramaj blocks the shot with his legs.
63' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Diant Ramaj comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
61' Heidenheim are seeing far more of the ball now.

58' 1 - 1 Goal! Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) neatly controls a decent pass from Mathias Honsak. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the left side of the goal from the edge of the box. 1:1.
57' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' Heidenheim fail to score from a corner as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaps to collect the ball.
54' The possession of the ball – 50:50.
52' Heidenheim keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
50' A lofted cross from Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
49' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
48' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) again sends a long-range pass to his teammate to start a counter attack.
47' Freiburg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Julian Niehues. He is replaced by Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
45+2' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) sends an accurate short pass. Bruno Ogbus controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Some great controlled play and passing from Heidenheim. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

44' Close! Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
44' Heidenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

43' Superb touch by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save! Heidenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' Some neat passing and movement from Freiburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
40' A corner kick by Freiburg is thwarted by the well prepared Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim).
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing. The ball goes out for a corner. Freiburg can continue in their attacking effort.
38' OFF THE BAR! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
37' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
35' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
32' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
32' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.
31' A long pass, executed by Noah Atubolu (Freiburg), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
30' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
28' A rebound falls for Christian Gunter (Freiburg), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender.

27' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The ball is out of play. Freiburg will have a throw-in.
27' A player from Heidenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Vincenzo Grifo passes the ball to Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Diant Ramaj couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
23' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
23' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle. Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Heidenheim.
22' Foul! Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
21' A pass by Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
19' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Freiburg have a corner.
18' Some patient build-up play from Freiburg as they look to unlock the defence.
17' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
15' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
14' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
12' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends a chip pass into the box, but Noah Atubolu is quickest to intercept the ball.
11' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle and it's Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

9' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.

8' Heidenheim are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
8' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim).
4' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
3' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Patrick Ittrich no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Freiburg will kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich was nominated as the referee for this game.
